_comment: Default vcs-personality banner profile. Same shape as VCS output, branded vamos. To change it, copy this file to banners/<name>.json in a later configuration layer and edit it (e.g. set brand); the layers, lowest first: this package, the site layer etc/vamos/ in the directory above the package (PREFIX/etc/vamos/ when installed), ~/.config/vamos/ ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/vamos/), ~/.vamos/, ./.vamos/. The last layer that has the file wins and replaces the whole profile, so copy every key. Select it with --vamos-banner=<name|path> or $VAMOS_BANNER (default: the profile named after the personality, vcs). Placeholders: {brand} {Brand} {BRAND} {BRAND_SPACED} {version} {personality} {tops_lines} {exe} (the executable, relative to the current directory) {cpu} {cpu_compile} {cpu_elab} {simtime} {status}. There is deliberately no slot for vendor licence/copyright text.
compile_done:
{Brand}: ./{exe} is up to date
CPU time: {cpu_compile:.3f} seconds to compile + {cpu_elab:.3f} seconds to elab
